name: quickjs
description: Run JavaScript expressions and functions inside DuckDB SQL with QuickJS. Pass row values as arguments or return arrays through the table function.

cta.title: JavaScript in Your SELECT
cta.description: Install QuickJS to run snippets and functions written in JavaScript inside DuckDB queries — JSON munging, custom transforms, anything ES2020 can express.

quickStart.title: Call JavaScript with SQL values
quickStart.description: The SQL values become arguments to the JavaScript function. QuickJS returns its result as JSON.
quickStart.sql:
WITH values_to_scale(n) AS (VALUES (3), (7))
SELECT n, quickjs_eval('(value) => value * 2', n) AS doubled
FROM values_to_scale
ORDER BY n;
quickStart.note: Use DuckDB expressions for simple arithmetic in real queries. This small example shows the argument boundary for JavaScript logic that SQL does not already provide.

introduction.title: Use JavaScript for a transformation inside SQL
paragraphs: QuickJS embeds a JavaScript engine in DuckDB. You pass SQL values to JavaScript expressions or functions and use their results in the surrounding query. A table form can turn a returned array into rows.

Use it when you already have JavaScript transformation logic or need to handle a custom structure. The embedded engine is not a Node.js process, so Node-specific modules are not automatically available. Ordinary SQL remains useful for operations DuckDB already expresses directly.
